mechanism: Betamethasone may increase topiramate metabolism via CYP3A4 induction and increase renal clearance, potentially reducing topiramate levels and efficacy; topiramate may increase corticosteroid metabolism and affect electrolyte balance.
action: Monitor topiramate and betamethasone efficacy; consider topiramate level monitoring; adjust doses if needed; monitor for hypokalemia and electrolyte abnormalities during concurrent use.
